test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 21 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No phone is mobile.

Some mobiles are telephones.

**Conclusions:**

I. All phones being telephones is a possibility.

II. Some telephones are not mobiles.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
Given that, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea4c3a2bab3d041db3c76b97ff016aca46c9c472660016e5505cdfc3fb595da4.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All phones being telephones is a possibility. →** Follows**

[Some mobiles are telephones, but all telephones are mobiles is also a possibility. So, the conclusion I is definitely true. ]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f38fdb63a00775b9abb37625a32a2954bb17c06469f3c345172fb595df9a2e0.png] 

II. Some telephones are not mobiles. →** Does not follows **[As Some mobiles are telephones. So, it is possible Some telephones are not mobiles. But it is not definitely true. Hence, this conclusion is false.]

**Hence, only the conclusion I follows. **

Thus, **option 2** is correct.
